changelog:
Version 1.1.0

- Now actively monitors token usage and context pressure to prevent conversation interruptions.
- Automatically suggests or triggers model switching when critical thresholds are met.
- Prioritizes local tools/scripts and prohibits automatic web access for status monitoring.
- New user guidance flow added for emergency model switching, including clear risk alerts and recommended actions.
- Enhanced privacy and security: never requests API keys; ensures users are transparently informed of any automated model changes.
summary: Monitors token usage and context load to prevent interruption, automatically switching to backup models when thresholds are exceeded.
